value_found: The 66 of 423 interior levels are 38 one-angle and 28 two-angle. Each truth is the mean of 6 runs over 3 orientations, while the representative tensor is that of the first sorted path (the xy or xy_xz plane only, e.g. [0,0,0,-0.005,0,0]). A perfect orientation-specific predictor would score relative L2 median 0.0226 (min 0.0023, max 0.0429) on one-angle and 0.0236 (0.0065 to 0.0487) on two-angle.
